title: 60oz glass pitcher
text: 60oz glass pitcher. It's light and beautiful.  The lid has a silicone gasket and a ice cube strainer and one pour without.  I will say that the pour that is 'open' is very small.  My larger cubes would never get through it.  In case that matters to anyone.  I hand wash it.  It doesn't sweat a lot when filled with ice water.  I don't pour hot water in it, but ad says you can.  Just wait until hot liquid cools before adding ice.  The handle is a yellow hue.  The body has an embossed texture.  Four our family of 3 it holds just enough water and ice to refill glasses during a meal.  THE BUMMER IS:  It SWEATS HORRIBLY with iced and cold drinks.  It is NOT double walled, I should have noticed that.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
